style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, slapstick, bright daylight, camera always moving
character: lanky stubbly shift-worker mosquito, heavy-lidded eyes, long proboscis, work shirt
cast: the cow filmed FROM HER SIDE: a broad brown flank fills the background, her head far left in profile chewing, she lows aloud; the hide ripples where he touches it
props: SACK: glossy ruby-red ball-sack on straps with a brass spout, keeps its round shape; empty until 7.3, swelling in hard pulses 7.3-9.3, full in the grass at the end. GLASS: one tall glass, filled at 4.2, drained by 5.85
setting: first half: blazing midday sun on a wooden terrace table, bleached boards. From 5.85: sunlit meadow, the cow side-on, flank and profile in frame, hard sun

audio.delivery: weary deadpan male chest voice near 130 Hz, even 4.3 syllables/sec
audio.pacing: one pause only, 7.3-7.9; the 4.5 and 5.85 lines run together with no breath; endings voiced, nothing after 9.3
audio.lip_sync: mouth opens and closes clearly on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: a loud cow moo through the whole second half, the sack gulping in hard pulses, tail whoosh at 9.3

timeline.a: silent. Point-blank mic; he recoils whole-body, the sack swinging wide and knocking his hind legs out
he marches straight at the lens until his head fills the frame, the sack swinging a full circle onto his back
timeline.cam: pushes in as he closes on the lens

timeline.a: silent. He swings the sack onto the table, BAM: it bounces and rounds back, the glass jumps. His back is bare
timeline.cam: drops low, bounces with the hit

timeline.a: he throws his whole body into one continuous sweep for the whole line: legs lash edge to edge, the sack blurs past the lens in a red streak, dust rolling across the frame
silent. He heaves the sack overhead, a ruby stream blasts across the whole frame into the glass, filling it to the brim
timeline.cam: cranes up, swings down to the glass

timeline.a: he shoves the full glass into the lens until it fills the frame, tips it back and drains it in one pull
timeline.cam: pushes into the glass, pulls back

timeline.a: same sentence, no breath. He slams the glass so it bounces, launches off the table past the lens; cut to the meadow, he lands on the cow's SIDE, her head chewing far left, hide rippling
timeline.cam: tracks the launch; cuts to the flank

timeline.a: silent, the only pause. Close on the bite: his proboscis drives into the cow's side and the sack behind him jerks and swells in hard pulses across the frame
timeline.cam: pushes in on the swelling sack

timeline.a: his face turns to the lens; the sack behind him keeps swelling, pulses bulging bigger
timeline.cam: pulls back to a moving three-quarter shot, face and swelling sack together

timeline.a: silent. The cow's tail whips across the entire frame and slams him out of it
silent. Bare rippling hide, the tail swinging back, the full ruby sack lying in the grass below
timeline.cam: settles on the hide and sack

must_appear: the cow seen side-on with her head in frame, the bite into her side at 7.3, the sack swelling in hard pulses 7.3-9.3, the tail crossing the frame at 9.3
